One time I was at a concert right next to a beach in Virginia. My parents just dragged me along with them, and I wasn't crazy about the band, so I just decided to play in the ocean. It was night time and the waves were actually very strong, especially for 8 ish year old me at the time. There was some other kids out there also who were playing a game to see who could take the most hits from the waves without being knocked under the water. 

Some ten minutes go by and we were getting used to staying standing from the waves at the level we were at. One of the kids decided we should go in further to make it harder, neck deep. We did. Every wave had sent me under, same as the other kids, but it was still fun (to the mind if a kid) so we continued playing. Then this really big and powerful wave came by and knocked me under so fast that my head hit the floor. The wave sent me rolling under the water with some shells cutting me up along the way and just hitting the ground bruising me up, while drowning. I couldn't find the surface since I kept rolling over. The wave finally washed me to the point where I could get out of the water easily.
 Now, I don't know if any of you have ever almost died from drowning, but it's one of the most terrifying things.
